title: Bill 75 agricultural tourism on working farms
summary: The council passed Bill 75 on second and final reading with seven ayes on July 25, 2025. The final version had only non-substantive changes and County legal approval. The bill allows agricultural tourism as an accessory use on working farms in the County agriculture district, and its sponsor said it gives farmers more options and will increase food security.
